# Success criteria — NN-kebab-name

Index for slice verification checklists (**SC-xx**). Evaluated at `/v` or `/v+codex` closeout — not a substitute for pytest.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [traceability.md](traceability.md) | AC → SC-xx → verify → PASS/FAIL matrix (**Cursor** creates at task sync) |
| [closeout.md](closeout.md) | Aggregated SC-xx checklists |
| [reference-scenario.md](reference-scenario.md) | Stable fixture for UI/mockup review (when applicable) |
| [_screen_-mockup-checklist.md](_screen_-mockup-checklist.md) | Per-screen element checklist (mockup-driven slices) |

## SC-xx index (PM drafts at requirements time)

| Id | Title | Maps to acceptance # | verify |
|----|-------|----------------------|--------|
| SC-01 | _…_ | 1 | _Cursor fills at task sync / build_ |

## Closeout rule

Slice **cannot** mark final-phase tasks complete until every SC-xx row is PASS, FAIL with approved deviation, or N/A with rationale — and **`traceability.md`** reflects the same PASS/FAIL/N/A with evidence links.
